excerpts.content:
Small change in EOF spec: we disallow CALLF to non-returning functions, allowing only JUMPF:

> `CALLF` operand must not point to to a section with `0x80` as outputs (non-returning)

This prevents doing awkward stack validation of the code after such CALLF, which is in practice unreachable and shouldn't be validated.
